BiblicalUsage: Zethan is a Benjamite, one of the sons of Bilhan, named once in the genealogy of Benjamin. He has no story beyond the list — a name kept in the tribe's record, a son of Bilhan among his brothers. His full story lives on his People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the lists keep faith with ordinary men: Zethan's name is written, and that is enough to remember him.
